summary_en: This Phase 2 study tests a single high-dose radiation session aimed at the MRI-visible tumor inside the prostate, in men with prostate cancer, with or without ultra-short-term hormone therapy using relugolix. Radiation is given once on the first day of treatment, and relugolix is taken as a daily oral tablet for 28 days, starting 2 weeks before radiation and continuing 2 weeks after. The record does not state a main outcome measure; it describes the study as Phase 2.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 2 prueba una sesión única de radiación de dosis alta dirigida al tumor visible en la resonancia magnética dentro de la próstata, en hombres con cáncer de próstata, con o sin terapia hormonal de duración muy corta con relugolix. La radiación se administra una vez el primer día del tratamiento, y el relugolix se toma como tableta oral diaria durante 28 días, comenzando 2 semanas antes de la radiación y continuando 2 semanas después. El registro no indica una medida de resultado principal; describe el estudio como de fase 2.
who_for: Biopsy-confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma with Gleason score 6 to 10
No spread to lymph nodes or distant sites by clinical or imaging tests
PSA 100 ng/mL or lower within 3 months of consent
not_for: Prior pelvic radiotherapy or prior androgen ablation therapy
Pelvic lymph nodes or distant metastasis, per imaging or pathology criteria
Other active cancer, except nonmetastatic skin cancer or early-stage CLL
Zubrod status above 2 or inability to tolerate diagnostic MRI
